abilities: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Training Token, then one ally you can see (other than yourself) heals 2 and gains 2 Power tokens.
After you spend a Training Token, give 1 Training Token to an ally you can see, other than yourself.

actions.name: Watch Closely
actions.text:
You gain 1 Training Token.
6+: You gain 1 Training Token.
9+: You gain 1 Training Token. Training Token: This Unique Token is only used by Training Style.

styles.description: You can only use Training Tokens while you are the active character. After any Action you perform, if you still have numbers in your Action Pool, you may spend 1 Training token to increase one of those numbers by 2. You may only spend 1 Training token per Action. Training Tokens have a Token Cap of 4, instead of 10.

supers.name: My Final Technique
supers.effect: Deal 99 damage to an enemy within range, then remove yourself from play for the rest of combat. You cannot come back.
supers.description: The Teacher's Alpha Super ends their involvement in this combat, but it also ends whoever they point it at. A devastating blow, as much to its user as its target, that is only to be used in desperation. While you are taken out by My Final Technique, you cannot use the Comeback Rule and you cannot be Rescued. You are simply gone. When your turn rolls around, you always give out your Heroic Spirit.

supers.name: Transcendant Spirit
supers.effect: This is only usable while you are Taken Out, and does not require any numbers to perform. When you pass on your Heroic Spirit, you may declare you are using this Super Move. If you do, instead of rolling your Action Dice this turn, give them the maximum number each of those dice could have generated. Then, add an 8 to their Action Pool, give them a 4-point Shield, and they heal.
supers.description: The Teacher's Delta Super isn't even a technique they use themselves - instead, it is their teachings coming to fruition. You give an ally the best Heroic Spirit turn possible, with an extra number, some healing, and a shield on top of everything.

name: Trickster
description: Everyone loves a good trick, unless the trick was played on them. Tricksters revel in confusion, changing the rules as they go. As long as you can stay one step ahead, nobody can handle you. Tricksters are the Iron token masters, converting your ally's Status tokens and your enemy's buffs into more and more Iron. Once you've had a little time to build up, you can unleash an endless wave of Token Actions to interrupt your foes and reshape the battlefield. Tricksters are extremely powerful when they have everything they need, but they rely on a lot of things to keep their tricks rolling. You need to build up a pile of tokens to spend on your various Unique Actions, and Trickster Abilities take their sweet time building those up for you. More than any other Archetype, Tricksters need careful planning so you don't run out of tricks right when you need them most. Tricksters are hard to pin down, hard to fight reliably, and hard to deal with. You may not deal the most damage, but you'll give your enemies hell trying to keep up with everything you've got going on. Nothing is easy when you're fighting a Trickster.
focused: At the start of each turn, you may target 1 non-Unique token held by someone within range of you or your Copies, then choose one or both:
Steal the chosen token; -and/or-
Convert the chosen token into an Iron token.
fused: At the start of each allied turn, you may target 1 non-Unique token held by someone within range of you or your Copies, then choose one or both:
Steal the chosen token; -and/or-
Convert the chosen token into an Iron token.
frantic: Until your next turn, at the start of each turn, you may target 1 non-Unique token held by someone within range of you or your Copies, then choose one or both:
Steal the chosen token; -and/or-
Convert the chosen token into an Iron token.

actions.name: Bag Of Tricks
actions.text:
Bag of Tricks can be used as either a Dice Action or a Token Action. To pay for Bag of Tricks, choose one or more: Spend a 2+ and 1 HP; -or- Spend a 3+; -or- spend 2 Iron tokens; -or- spend 3 Speed tokens; -or- pay 3 HP.
X is equal to the number of costs paid.
Choose X: Create a Copy within range and swap spaces with it; -or- Create a Pit Trap in an empty space within range; -or- Move up to 2, then swap spaces with an obstacle within range; -or- Pull 3 to an enemy you can see and they discard 1 token; -or- Give 2 Weakness tokens to an enemy within range.
Usable once per turn. Bag of Tricks has 5 alternative costs. For each you pay, you choose one additional option from the list, to a maximum of all 5 choices if you pay with a 2+ and 1 HP, a 3+, 2 Iron tokens, 3 Speed tokens, and 3 HP. The target of the fourth option of Bag of Tricks decides which token they want to discard. Swapping Spaces is not reduced by Fatigue tokens, and doesn't discard any Fatigue Tokens either.

styles.name: Caged
abilities: Adjacent enemies cannot gain or spend Speed tokens, and any Action Movement they would take is reduced to zero.

actions.name: Welcome To My Maze
actions.text: Deal 1 damage and Pull 3 to an enemy you can see.

actions.name: Rat Trap
actions.text:
Rat Trap can be used as either a Dice or Token Action. Deal 1 damage and give 2 Fatigue tokens to each adjacent enemy.
Usable once per turn.

styles.description: Caged Style traps your enemies until you're ready to let them go.

styles.name: Hidden
abilities: At the start of your turn, place Fog into your space.
While you stand in Fog, you have Armor and your maximum range is increased by 3.

actions.name: Ghost Walk
actions.text: Place a Fog obstacle into an empty space within range. Then, teleport to an empty space both within Fog and within range. The Mysterious Ability replaces an obstacle in your space with Fog.

styles.description: You can pay for Ghost Walk with any quantity of each token, as long as you spend a total of 3 tokens. 3 Speed, 2 Speed and 1 Iron, 2 Iron and 1 Speed, and 3 Iron tokens are all legal costs to pay for Ghost Walk. Mysterious Style strikes from hiding, using Fog to be untouchable.

styles.name: Mirrored
abilities: After you spend Iron tokens, you may deal 1 damage to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.
Your Copies have 2 HP each.
You may spend Iron tokens to Reduce Hits to your Copies.

actions.name: Reflections of the Self
actions.text:
Place a Copy into an empty space within range, then gain 2 Iron tokens.
6+: Place a Copy into an empty space within range, then gain 2 Iron tokens.

actions.name: Shatter
actions.text:
Target one of your Copies. It deals 1 damage to each enemy within its range. At the end of this turn, destroy that Copy.
Usable once per turn.

styles.description: Mirrored Style punishes enemies who try to hurt you without clearing out your Copies. Once you set up, it takes a lot of effort to set you back.

styles.name: Parkour
abilities: You may move through and stand on top of Walls as though they were empty spaces. You can see and target enemies through Walls.
After you end movement within a Wall's space, you may Move 1.

actions.name: Take Cover
actions.text:
Place a Wall into an empty adjacent space.
5+: Place up to three more Walls into empty spaces within range, then gain 2 Iron tokens.

actions.name: From Above!
actions.text:
Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.
Usable once per turn.

styles.description: The Hidden Ability lets you stand in Walls. A Wall you are standing in does not block line of sight to you. Hidden Style is a defense oriented Style, but is generically useful with any Form you want to pair it with.

styles.name: Whip
abilities: Your Throw Actions may target within range.
After you Throw or Grapple an enemy, you deal 2 damage to them.

actions.name: Grapple Hook
actions.text: Grapple Hook can be used as either a Dice or Token Action. Choose one or both: An ally within range teleports to an empty space within your range of their choice; -and/or- you teleport to an empty space within range. The Whip Ability prevents you from Throwing adjacent enemies.

styles.description: Whip Style is a zoning Style, staying out of enemy range and keeping your enemies from getting close.

supers.name: Funny Little Box Of Pain
supers.effect: Target an enemy at Range 2. Push everyone adjacent to the target one space. Then, place Walls into each space adjacent to the target, place a Deadly Trap beneath them, and give them 5 Fatigue tokens.
supers.description: The Trickster's Alpha Super traps its target in a tiny prison. While it is not inescapable, it is difficult to flee from, and their allies will be hard-pressed to save them before they are overwhelmed. The Deadly Trap is like a regular Trap, except for two things: Whenever it triggers, it deals 2 damage instead of 1 damage; and the Deadly Trap cannot be removed by Actions or Abilities.

supers.name: Steal Strength
supers.effect: Target an adjacent character. They discard all tokens they hold, and you gain Iron tokens equal to the number of tokens discarded.
supers.description: The Trickster's Delta Super is not a deadly move, but it is very, very cruel. Not only do you take all they have built, but you also convert it into tons of blocking potential. Whether you steal a Boss's pile of basic tokens, or convert all the burning tokens of an ally on fire into your own health, Steal Strength will destroy the enemy's plans and leave you nearly invulnerable on top of that. Super Tokens cannot be discarded by any means, even by other Super Moves like Steal Strength.

name: Underdog
description: You're just a regular kid, and you're in way over your head. Or you would be, if being an ordinary underdog didn't make you the most dangerous person in the room at all times. The harder they hit you down, the more they underestimate you, the stronger you rise back up. Underdogs rely on a bit of luck and a lot of tenacity. They're hard to keep down, and things just keep working out for them somehow. Even when it doesn't look like it, as they bumble into traps or slip and fall away from their enemies, every mistake is their good luck in disguise.
focused: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Luck Tokens.
The first two times you take damage each turn, you gain 1 Basic token of your choice.
fused: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Luck Token.
The first time you take damage each turn, you gain 1 Basic token of your choice.
frantic: At the start of this turn, you gain 2 Luck Tokens.
Until your next turn, the first two times you take damage each turn, you gain 1 Basic token of your choice.

actions.name: Just What I Needed
actions.text:
Choose one: Teleport 3; -or- Push 2 and deal 2 damage to an enemy within range; -or- you gain temporary Armor.
Usable once per turn.

notes: Just What I Needed essentially lets you convert any 4 basic tokens into one specific type, right at the moment you need it most. You can run away as if you had Speed, deal damage as if you had Power, or block a big hit as if you had Iron. The unusual wording of the second half of the Underdog Abilities is that way so end of turn damage from Traps and Burning Tokens will count towards gaining Luck. End of Turn effects happen before those trigger, so it has to be a "start of turn" trigger to count that damage. Luck Tokens are a Unique Token used only by the Underdog. They protect you in unforeseen ways, allowing you to evade danger and keep up with the fight even in the worst situations. Once per turn, after any Action fully resolves, you may spend 1 Luck Token to Teleport 3 and Heal 1. 1 Luck Token may also be used to pay for (part of) any Token Action, in place of up to 3 Basic Tokens, 3 HP, or 3 Shield. This can be used as often as you have Luck Tokens and costs to reduce.

styles.name: Collateral
abilities: After you deal damage to an enemy with an Action, you may destroy 1 obstacle within range per enemy dealt damage.
At the end of your turn, you gain 1 Power token per obstacle you destroyed during that turn.

actions.name: Roughhousing
actions.text:
As an additional cost, you may pay 2 or 4 Basic Tokens. Choose one: Place Rubble into up to 3 adjacent spaces; -or- Pull 1 and deal 1 damage to up to two enemies within range; -or- Move 3 and deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.
2 Basic Tokens: Choose two instead.
4 Basic Tokens: Choose three instead.

styles.description: Collateral Style tears the arena apart. If your enemies were relying on walls and traps to protect themselves, Collateral will put a stop to that.

styles.name: Distracting
abilities: After an enemy deals damage to you with an Action, give that enemy 1 Weakness token.
Your Challenge tokens cannot be discarded by enemy Actions or Abilities.

actions.name: Flare
actions.text:
Flare can be paid for as either a Dice Action or a Token Action. Move 2, then give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range.
5+ -or-
6 Basic Tokens: Give them 2 more Weakness tokens, give them 2 Burning tokens, then Challenge them.

styles.description: Distracting Style makes you the perfect distraction. Hard to catch and hard to hit, you can outlast all but the most aggressive assaults. Be sure to Challenge your enemies, so the distraction works!

styles.name: Lucky
abilities: Add d4 to your Action Dice.
You have Armor.

actions.name: Slip Up
actions.text:
Move 2.
2 HP: Push 2 to someone within range, then Move 1.
3 HP: Deal 1 damage to someone within range, then Move 1.
Usable once per turn.

styles.description: Lucky Style is basic, but extremely solid, granting you both Armor and an extra Action each turn. It combines well with any Form.

styles.name: Misfortune's
abilities: After you take damage from anything other than an Action or an Ability, choose one: You deal 1 damage to an enemy within range; -or- you heal 2.

actions.name: Bad Luck
actions.text:
Place X Traps into empty spaces within range.
Usable once per turn. X cannot be greater than 4.

actions.name: Karma
actions.text:
Deal X damage and give 4 Weakness tokens to the active character.
X is equal to the amount of HP you have lost this turn.
Usable once per turn.
Usable only during enemy turns.

styles.description: Misfortune's Style turns your bad luck around, filling the terrain with Traps while becoming immune to them yourself. Damage that does not come from Actions or Abilities includes: Damage from Traps, from Pits, from Fall Damage, and from Burning Tokens. Karma does not have any range requirements. The target is the active character, regardless of where they are or where you are.

styles.name: Scrambling
abilities: At the start of your turn, you gain 1 Power token and 1 Iron token.
After you spend Power tokens, you gain 1 Speed token.
After you spend Iron tokens, you gain 1 Speed token.
When you discard Speed tokens at the end of each turn, you do not discard below 2 Speed tokens.

actions.name: Think Fast!
actions.text:
Target an enemy within range and Choose one: Give them 1 Weakness token; -or- give them 1 Fatigue token; -or- Push 3. Then, you may Move 2.
4 Basic Tokens: Choose two instead.
5 Basic Tokens: Choose three instead.

styles.description: Scrambling Style keeps moving. If any enemy gets too close, just throw something at their face, or knock over a convenient pile of bricks, and keep running until you can turn the tide.

supers.name: Lucky Hit
supers.effect: Deal 4 damage to an adjacent enemy. Then, that enemy discards all Basic tokens they hold, discards all Shields they hold, and cannot have Armor or Shields for the rest of this Round.
supers.description: The Underdog's Alpha Super strikes juuuust the right spot to completely destroy their defenses. Their Shields are down, their Armor is cast side, and any preparations they were making are torn down.

supers.name: Hyper Install
supers.effect: You gain 3 Luck tokens and you heal. For the rest of this Round, you gain a benefit at the start of every single turn, depending on whose turn it is. If it is an enemy turn, you gain 1 Iron token and 1 Speed token. If it is an allied turn, you gain 1 Power token and heal 1. If it is your turn, you gain both effects: gain 1 Iron token, 1 Power token, 1 Speed token, and you heal 1.
supers.description: A panic button to trump all others. The Underdog's Delta Super gives you a ton of extra... everything. Speed, power, durability. It even picks you back up from zero HP, all round! The only problem is, it doesn't give you everything at once. You need to stick around a little, and use this very early in a Round, to get the most out of your Hyper Install.

name: Wardancer
description: damage dealing and mobility. Wardancer Styles are hyper-focused on specific kinds of aggression, giving you exactly the hammer you need to pound down any nail. Mechanically, the Wardancer has the highest numbers. All of their Unique Actions are Tiered Actions, and they get stronger when you spend larger numbers to use them. Their Ability increases their numbers after they roll, but they still favor Forms with large dice to begin with: Control, Dance, Power, Wild, and Zen Forms especially. The Wardancer is a very simple fighter to play. But simple doesn't mean weak, as they are unrivaled in raw power and speed.
focused: At the start of the Action Phase of your turn, increase one of your numbers by 3, a different one of your numbers by 2, and one of your remaining numbers by 1. This can only increase a number to a maximum value of 9.
fused: At the start of the Action Phase of your turn, increase one of your numbers by 2, and one of your other numbers by 1. This can only increase a number to a maximum value of 5.
frantic: At the start of the Action Phase of this turn, increase one of your numbers by 3, a different one of your numbers by 2, and one of your remaining numbers by 1. This can only increase a number to a maximum value of 9.

actions.name: War Dance
actions.text:
Move 1, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.
5+: Move 2, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.
9+: Move 3, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

notes: The Wardancer Abilities do not increase your numbers during Heroic Spirit turns, whether you give your dice or receive someone else's. When you receive Heroic Spirit, it isn't your turn, so the Ability will not trigger. When you give Heroic Spirit, you will give your numbers away before the Ability would trigger to enhance them.

styles.name: Artistic
abilities: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Iron tokens.
After you deal damage to, or Reduce a Hit from, an enemy, you may spend 1 Iron token to give them 1 Status token of your choice.

actions.name: Poetry In Motion
actions.text:
Move 1 and gain 1 Iron token.
4+: Move up to 2, gain 1 Iron token, and gain 1 Power token.
7+: Move up to 3, gain 1 Iron token, and gain 1 Power token.

styles.description: Artistic Style paints a beautiful picture upon your enemies.

styles.name: Overwhelming
abilities: Your Actions and Abilities are Unblockable by Armor.
At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Power tokens.
After an enemy deals damage to you with an Action, you may spend a Power token to deal 1 damage and Push 1 to your attacker.

actions.name: Power Strike
actions.text:
Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, then you gain 2 Power tokens.
8+: Deal 4 damage and gain 4 Power tokens instead.

styles.description: Overwhelming Style can break through the mightiest defenses, leaving your enemies reeling from your mere presence. Unblockable means "this defense can't be used." So, Armor cannot be used to reduce damage you deal while in Overwhelming Style.

styles.name: Relentless
abilities: Enemies holding your Challenge are within your range.
After you deal damage, Push 1.

actions.name: Hey.
actions.text:
Challenge an enemy within range.
Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Nothing Personal
actions.text:
This Action costs your Challenge token held by an enemy within range. You must discard one such token to pay for Nothing Personal. Nothing Personal targets the enemy who held the Challenge Token you spent to pay for Nothing Personal. Teleport to an empty space adjacent to that target, then deal 1 damage to them.
Usable once per turn.

styles.description: Relentless Style lets you smash your foes across the battlefield, Pushing them away with every strike. Once you have your target, they cannot escape you.

styles.name: Swift
abilities: Before each Reactive Action you perform, you may Move 1.
After each Action you perform, you gain 1 Speed token.

actions.name: Deadly Dance
actions.text:
Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.
4+: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.
6+: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.
8+: Teleport 2, then deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Swift Strike
actions.text:
Deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.
Usable once per turn, only during enemy turns.

styles.description: Swift Style is fast. Real fast. So fast they can't see it coming.

styles.name: Weightless
abilities: You do not take Fall Damage.
Rubble does not give you Fatigue.
All spaces are Empty spaces to you. You can move into and share a space with Copies, Walls, and other units.
All spaces cost 1 Speed token to enter using Free Movement. Ignore all additional Speed token costs, from leaving Pits or moving diagonally or any other source.

actions.name: Effortless
actions.text:
Teleport to an empty space you can see.
6+: Choose an ally within range. They may teleport to an empty space they can see.

styles.description: Weightless Style ignores trouble in a way no other Style can. You have no way of stopping their tricks, so why not just ignore them?

supers.name: Become My Canvas
supers.effect: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, ignoring Armor and Shields. Then, deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, ignoring Armor and Shields. Then, deal 3 damage to an enemy within range, ignoring Armor and Shields.
supers.description: The War Dancer's Alpha Super carves your name into your enemies, with a flurry of blows that ignore defenses and can either target one foe repeatedly, or be spread out among multiple foes within range.

supers.name: Lightning Drop
supers.effect: Teleport to any space on the map. Then, deal 4 damage to an adjacent enemy. Then, deal 2 damage to all enemies within Range 1-4.
supers.description: You disappear, then strike hard like a bolt from the blue. The War Dancer's Delta Super is excellent for punishing enemies that group up, and can get you out of a dangerous spot and into an advantageous one.

name: Winterblossom
description: foes, similar to the Angel. But while the Angel buffs herself into being untouchable, the Winterblossom weakens her foes into uselessness, before destroying them with a well-timed power blow. The Winterblossom has no problems against other defensive and controlling foes, winning the war of attrition with ease. But aggressive enemies are a problem, as they can dish out damage faster than you can stop it. One-Two Form is especially bad for you, as its users can remove two Weakness tokens per attack. But if you can pile on the Weakness tokens, your opponents will never be able to touch you.
focused: At the start of each turn, give 1 Weakness token to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.
fused: At the start of each allied turn, give 1 Weakness token to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.
frantic: At the start of each turn until your next turn, give 1 Weakness token to one enemy within range of you or your Copies.

actions.name: Frostbite
actions.text:
Give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range.
3+: Give 1 Weakness token to a different enemy within range.
5+: Give 1 Weakness token to up to two enemies within range.
8+: Give 1 Weakness token to up to three enemies within range.

notes: Focused and Frantic Winterblossoms give out a Weakness token at the start of every turn, not just yours. Each ally's turn, and each enemy's turn, if there are any enemies within your range, then you will give one of them a Weakness token. Fused Winterblossoms do the same, except they do not give out Weakness tokens during enemy turns.

styles.name: Avalanche
abilities: At the start of your turn, you may place up to three Walls into empty adjacent spaces.
You can see and target enemies through Walls.

actions.name: Walled In
actions.text:
Place up to 3 Walls into empty spaces within Range 1-3.
6+: Place up to 3 Walls into empty spaces within Range 1-3, then you may swap spaces with one Wall placed by Walled In.

actions.name: Icicle Fall
actions.text:
Deal 1 damage to each enemy adjacent to any Walls.
7+: Deal 2 damage instead, then give 1 Weakness token to each enemy dealt damage by Icicle Fall.

styles.description: Avalanche Style is the ultimate defensive combat style, building a wall to hide behind while you continue to strike out at your foes. Your defensive fortifications will never fall! Probably!

styles.name: Crystal
abilities: After you perform an Action with exactly one target, you deal 1 damage to all enemies adjacent to that target.
The first time each turn one of your Copies is destroyed, you may place a Copy within range of your Original.

actions.name: Splintered Mirror
actions.text: Place a Copy into an empty space within range. You may swap spaces with that Copy.

actions.name: Crystal Spike
actions.text:
Target one enemy within range. Deal 1 damage to them and give them 1 Weakness token.
7+: Deal 2 more damage and give 2 more Weakness tokens.

styles.description: Crystal Style creates explosive fragments of glass with everything it does, the shrapnel piercing nearby foes as you go. The Crystal Passive Ability requires the Action to target exactly one enemy, ally, or obstacle. If an Action could have multiple targets (such as Secure or Brambles) but you choose the same target for each, then the Crystal Ability will apply.

styles.name: Frozen
abilities: At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Iron tokens.
After you Reduce a Hit, give 1 Weakness token to your attacker.

actions.name: Exploit Weakness
actions.text:
Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. You may spend Weakness tokens they hold as if they were Power tokens you hold.
7+: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range. You may spend Weakness tokens they hold as if they were Power tokens you hold.

actions.name: Ice Block
actions.text: Gain 3 Iron tokens, then give 1 Weakness token to all adjacent enemies.

styles.description: Frozen Style makes it difficult to attack you, as anyone doing so has their strength stolen away from them.

styles.name: Heartless
abilities: Whenever you give Tokens to an enemy, you heal 1. This Ability cannot heal you more than the Bleed Value in a single turn.
Your Actions and Abilities are Unblockable by Shields.

actions.name: Block This
actions.text:
An enemy within range gains 1 Iron token, then you deal 4 damage to them. Unblockable by Iron Tokens.
Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Heart Strike
actions.text:
An enemy within range pays 2 HP and gains 1 Weakness token.
7+: That enemy pays 2 more HP and gains 2 Weakness tokens.

styles.description: Heartless Style punishes defensive strategies, crashing straight through their Shields. Your powerful (but expensive) Unique Actions pierce right through everything else. Unblockable means "this defense can't be used." So, Iron Tokens cannot be used to reduce damage dealt by Block This. Paying HP does not trigger Bleeding or any Abilities that trigger on taking or dealing damage. It cannot be reduced by Iron tokens, by Armor, by Shields, or by any defensive Abilities.

styles.name: Pressure
abilities: At the start and end of your turn, each enemy within range must pay 1 HP, then gain 1 Weakness token.

actions.name: Build Pressure
actions.text: Give an enemy within range 1 each of three different Status tokens of your choice (Burning, Challenge, Fatigue, or Weakness).

actions.name: Apply Pressure
actions.text:
Target an enemy within range. Deal damage to them equal to the number of Status tokens they hold, to a max of 12 damage.
Usable once per turn.

styles.description: Pressure Style is your big finisher. Once your enemies are drowning in Status tokens, Apply Pressure will destroy them.

supers.name: You Are Nothing.
supers.effect: Deal 4 damage to an enemy within range, Pull them up to 3, then give them Weakness tokens until they hold 6.
supers.description: The Winterblossom's Alpha Super brings them in and crushes their spirit. They will be helpless to harm you in the counter attack, even though you brought them right to you. How pathetic.

supers.name: Blizzard
supers.effect: Until the end of this Round, increase your maximum range by 2. Also until the end of this Round, at the end of every turn, you give 1 Fatigue token and 1 Weakness token to every enemy within range, then you may move 1 space.
supers.description: Expand your domain. The Winterblossom Delta Super Move acts
